item.title: US escalates its hostile campaign against Iran, targets four nationals with sanctions
item.description: New York, IRNA — The US Treasury Department has imposed new sanctions on four Iranian nationals involved in collecting oil revenues, continuing Washington’s economic pressure on Iran following its failure to achieve its objectives through war of aggression.

item.title: Iran’s Kanoon urges UNICEF to pursue justice for war-hit children
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s Institute for the Intellectual Development of Children and Young Adults (IIDCYA), better known as Kanoon, has called on the United Nations International Children’s Emergency Fund (UNICEF) to publicly condemn attacks that killed or injured Iranian children and pursue accountability for violations of their rights.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86327936/Iran-s-Kanoon-urges-UNICEF-to-pursue-justice-for-war-hit-children

Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s Institute for the Intellectual Development of Children and Young Adults (IIDCYA), better known as Kanoon, has called on the United Nations International Children’s Emergency Fund (UNICEF) to publicly condemn attacks that killed or injured Iranian children and pursue accountability for violations of their rights.

item.title: Iranians will never forget Minab school tragedy: Iran’s UN mission
item.description: New York, IRNA — The Permanent Mission of the Islamic Republic of Iran to the United Nations has stressed that Tehran will never forget the killing of 168 students and teachers in a missile attack on a school in the southern Iranian city of Minab, calling for the suffering of the victims to be heard and their memory preserved.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86327823/Iranians-will-never-forget-Minab-school-tragedy-Iran-s-UN-mission

New York, IRNA — The Permanent Mission of the Islamic Republic of Iran to the United Nations has stressed that Tehran will never forget the killing of 168 students and teachers in a missile attack on a school in the southern Iranian city of Minab, calling for the suffering of the victims to be heard and their memory preserved.

item.title: Armed Forces fully prepared to counter any hostile action: IRGC Aerospace Force adviser
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – A senior advisor to the commander of the Islamic Revolution Guard Corps (IRGC) Aerospace Force says Iran faces no restrictions on deploying its missile capabilities to new geographic areas if ordered, stressing that the country’s Armed Forces are fully prepared to respond decisively to any hostile action.
